parameters.query:
SELECT
    u.userid,
    u.fname,
    u.lname,
    u.lastrequest,
    COALESCE(
        json_agg(
            json_build_object(
                'mapping_id', f.id,
                'usecase_id', uc.usecase_id,
                'usecase_name', uc.name,
                'usecase_description', uc.description,
                'minvalue', f.minvalue,
                'maxvalue', f.maxvalue,
                'minpulses', f.minpulses,
                'maxpulses', f.maxpulses,
                'minintensity', f.minintensity,
                'maxintensity', f.maxintensity,
                'minduration', f.minduration,
                'maxduration', f.maxduration,
                'mininterval', f.mininterval,
                'maxinterval', f.maxinterval
            )
            ORDER BY uc.name, f.id
        ) FILTER (WHERE f.id IS NOT NULL),
        '[]'::json
    ) AS usecase_mappings
FROM "User" u
LEFT JOIN "User_UC_Mappings" uum
    ON uum.user_id = u.userid
LEFT JOIN feedback_config_rules f
    ON f.id = uum.feedback_config_rule_id
LEFT JOIN "UseCase" uc
    ON uc.usecase_id = f.usecase_id
GROUP BY
    u.userid,
    u.fname,
    u.lname,
    u.lastrequest
ORDER BY u.userid;

parameters.query:
WITH selected_rule AS (
    SELECT
        f.id,
        f.usecase_id
    FROM feedback_config_rules f
    JOIN "UseCase" uc
        ON uc.usecase_id = f.usecase_id
    WHERE f.usecase_id = $2
      AND f.active = TRUE
    ORDER BY
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(uc.name) = LOWER('HeartRate') AND f.id = 140 THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END,
        f.id ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
delete_old_user_mapping_for_same_usecase AS (
    DELETE FROM "User_UC_Mappings" uum
    USING feedback_config_rules old_rule, selected_rule new_rule
    WHERE uum.feedback_config_rule_id = old_rule.id
      AND uum.user_id = $1
      AND old_rule.usecase_id = new_rule.usecase_id
)
INSERT INTO "User_UC_Mappings" (user_id, feedback_config_rule_id)
SELECT
    $1,
    selected_rule.id
FROM selected_rule
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING
    user_id,
    feedback_config_rule_id;
